entries.key: Add a small wheel in the back to keep the tail out of the dirt.
entries.value: 在尾部加一个小轮子，别让机尾蹭到地面。

entries.key: Add the wing landing gear here.
entries.value: 在这里添加机翼起落架。

entries.key: Enable the hole cutting outlines by clicking the indicated button. You can also use the '/' key.
entries.value: 点击指示的按钮即可开启切孔轮廓线。也可以按“/”键。

entries.key: Let's reset the view now. Click the flashing button in the top right.
entries.value: 现在重置一下视角。点击右上角闪烁的按钮。

entries.key: Now click the Side View button.
Pro tip 2: Hold 'Left Shift' while moving or cloning to affect only the selected part. It also toggles Selected/Connected mode for the Rotate and Translate tools.
entries.value: 进阶技巧 2：移动或复制时按住“左 Shift”，可只影响选中的零件。它还能在旋转与平移工具中切换“仅选中／相连”模式。

entries.key: Select an engine to drive this exhaust.
entries.value: 选择一台发动机来驱动这个排气管。
选择被指示的机翼零件。

entries.key: That's it, you got it! Keep panning.
entries.value: 就是这样，你学会了！继续平移视角。

entries.key: That's it, you got it! Keep zooming in and out.
entries.value: 就是这样，你学会了！继续缩放视角。

entries.key: You can also pan the view around by right clicking and dragging. Go ahead and give it a try.
entries.value: 你也可以按住右键拖动来平移视角。去试试看吧。

entries.key: You can also zoom in and out with the mouse wheel. Go ahead and try it out.
entries.value: 你也可以用鼠标滚轮缩放。去试试看吧。
